target.title: fix(codex): classify commandExecution mutability via shared isMutatingToolCall
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #101890 — strict-agentic retry cannot retry terminal turns that only
performed read-only inspection tools because the Codex `isMutatingNativeToolItem`
always treats `commandExecution` items as mutating.

## Root Cause

`isMutatingNativeToolItem` returns `true` for all `commandExecution` items,
classifying even read-only commands (grep, ls, rg, cat) as having side effects.
This prevents strict-agentic retry from re-running terminal turns that only
inspected the workspace.

## Fix

1. Export `isMutatingToolCall` through the plugin SDK (`agent-harness-runtime`)
   alongside the already-exported `isReplaySafeToolCall`
2. Use `isMutatingToolCall("exec", itemToolArgs(item))` in
   `isMutatingNativeToolItem` instead of `return true`

## Evidence

### Source-Level Proof

```
isMutatingToolCall("exec", { command: "rg TODO src" })   → false (read-only)
isMutatingToolCall("exec", { command: "grep foo ." })    → false (read-only)
isMutatingToolCall("exec", { command: "cat file.txt" })  → false (read-only)
isMutatingToolCall("exec", { command: "rm -rf /tmp" })   → true  (mutating)
isMutatingToolCall("exec", { command: "npm install" })   → true  (mutating)
isMutatingToolCall("exec", { command: "echo > /tmp/x" }) → true  (redirect)
```

### Regression Test

`outcome-fallback-runtime-contract.test.ts` — 7 table-driven cases: read-only
(rg, grep, ls, cat) → `replaySafe: true`; mutating (echo redirect, rm, npm) →
`replaySafe: false`.

### Autoreview (claude-sonnet-5)

```
→ patch is correct (0.98), no accepted/actionable findings

"This change defensively and correctly reclassifies commandExecution items
from always-mutating to delegating to isMutatingToolCall. The full
propagation chain is correct: isMutatingNativeToolItem → hadPotentialSideEffects
→ replayMetadata. Tests cover 7 command cases across the read-only and
mutating spectrum."
```

### Test Results

```
pnpm test extensions/codex/src/app-server/outcome-fallback-runtime-contract.test.ts
  Tests  7 passed
```

- [x] `oxfmt --check` passes
- [x] `oxlint` passes
- [x] `git diff --check` passes
- [x] autoreview clean (claude-sonnet-5, 0.98)
